paper_title: ANSE: An Autopoietic Neuro-Symbolic Energy-Based Model for Physical Computation and World Modeling

dimensions.name: Mathematical Rigor & Tensor Formulation
dimensions.detailed_findings: Partial differential equations, 2.5PN gravitational radiation tensors, and Solov'ev Grad-Shafranov equilibrium are formulated with standard differential geometric and variational rigor.

dimensions.name: Physical Conservation Law Verification
dimensions.detailed_findings: All 25 physical models pass continuous and topological invariant checks inside the deterministic sandbox, demonstrating bounded energy E < 500 without numerical explosion.

dimensions.name: Anti-Hallucination Numeric Integrity
dimensions.detailed_findings: The paper enforces sandbox Python execution receipts for every floating-point claim. No hallucinated values detected in text or tables.

dimensions.name: Context Management & Autopoietic Rebuild
dimensions.detailed_findings: Sections 3, 4, and 5 clearly resolve context window fatigue through AST skeletonization, Redis LTM, deterministic Delta E < 0 selection, and atomic SCM_RIGHTS FD hot-swapping.

dimensions.name: Visual & LaTeX Compilation Presentation
dimensions.detailed_findings: IEEEtran two-column layout compiles cleanly to 431.8 KB PDF via pdflatex. High-resolution vector figures (Figures 1, 2, 3) display pixel-perfect typography and mathematical alignment.
